title: Juice N Power Blueberry Pomegranate Power Salt 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Pomegranate from Juice N Power is an insanely pairing of classic blueberry and exotic pomegranate. The smooth, rich tang of fresh blueberries collide with the subtle sour notes of pomegranate for an incredible rush of fruity flavour. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
